content: next-intl 4.13.6 is current stable (v4 released March 2025). ESM-only, TypeScript 5+ required. Uses createNavigation + createMiddleware for path-based routing (/de, /en). Middleware handles locale detection via Accept-Language header, cookie, then defaultLocale. Provides alternates/hreflang via metadata alternates.languages API and sitemap(). Breaking: NextIntlClientProvider required around all client components.
